text:
alejandra: quick sync  morning  - noticed some tenants got auto-swapped to v2 by the new routing heuristics and their invoices jumped. need clearer telemetry and pin heuristics in the console.
brian: +1. spike at ~07:18 UTC. interestingly it's correlated with high seq_len variance rather than mean. we should surface seq_len_p90 and seq_len_var by route.
yousef: can we add a "routing-risk" score that's shown inline in the console routes list? e.g. risk = f(seq_len_p95, batch_rate, token_velocity). if >0.7, render amber and prevent one-click auto-switch.
audit-bot: auto: alert annotated: affected_tenants=7, avg_token_increase_p95=28%, suggested_action=account_pin_candidate
mira: UX idea: add a compact metric column "risk" + a hover tooltip with the drivers. add an affordance to preview cost impact before flipping.
zhen: runtime note: pinning currently is last-writes-wins. we need a provenance model: who pinned, whether auto or manual, TTL, and a confidence label if auto. also add metrics tag pinned_by=pipeline|human and pin_method=route|account.
brian: telemetry specification: emit pre_pin_token_rate, post_pin_token_rate, projected_savings_estimate, pin_scope, pin_actor, pin_confidence. include a tag pin_trigger=telemetry_alert if auto.
yousef: for auto-pinning heuristics: require at least two signals (high risk score + projected_hourly_cost_delta>threshold) and owner opt-in. when auto-pin runs, send owner notification + create an audit entry.
alejandra: UX safety: quick-pin should default TTL=4h and require an audit reason. account-pin must be two-step with explicit owner ack. add a small banner when an auto-pin is active linking to runbook steps to revert.
mira: runbook snippet: steps to detect candidate -> dry-run route with routing_preview tag -> measure token delta for 15m -> apply ephemeral pin via API -> monitor for 30m -> escalate if savings < X%. will add curl examples.
zhen: curl example for ephemeral pin:
```bash
curl -X POST https://console.internal/api/pins \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"scope":"route","route":"/v1/embeds","version":"v1","ttl":"4h","reason":"auto-cost-defense","actor":"telemetry-agent","confidence":"0.86"}'
```
brian: important detail: runtime affinity means pinned changes won't be immediate for existing connections. expose connection_drain_seconds and a "flush-affinity" action with warnings. log flush events in audit trail.
yousef: telemetry retention: keep pin events and pre/post metrics for 90 days to help billing disputes. mark events with correlation_id so we can join with invoices.
audit-bot: auto: follow-up reminder scheduled in 45m.
alejandra: next steps: mira -> runbook + preview UI mock; zhen -> API schema + telemetry tags; brian -> risk score calc + console column; yousef -> owner opt-in flow and notification template. I'll own comms to SRE and billing.
mira: will post mock by EOD.
zhen: will open PR for schema.
yousef: i'll prototype notification template and opt-in checkbox (default off).
alejandra: thanks all. low-friction changes first: telemetry tags + preview UI, then risk score and auto-pin policy after we have data.
